_docs.wallets: Array of { address, label, primary }. Plain "0x.." strings are also accepted. resolveWallet(cfg) uses the first primary:true entry, else wallets[0]; placeholder addresses (<like-this>) count as unconfigured. Select a specific wallet by label, address, or index.
_docs.budgets: dataType -> daily USDC cap; 0 or missing means unlimited for that type.
_docs.registries.local: Path to a local provider catalog JSON (bare array or {endpoints:[...]}). registry.seed.json ships preloaded Puls endpoints.
_docs.registries.discovery: When true (default), merge Circle x402 Discovery results filtered to cfg.chain.
